def sort_matrix_rows_by_first_elem_then_sum(matrix):
    rows = list(matrix)
    n = len(rows)
    for i in range(1, n):
        current = rows[i]
        cur_key = (current[0], sum(current))
        j = i - 1
        while j >= 0 and (rows[j][0], sum(rows[j])) > cur_key:
            rows[j + 1] = rows[j]
            j -= 1
        rows[j + 1] = current
    return rows

def nth_weekend_day_from(day_num, n):
    dow = day_num % 7
    to_first = 0 if dow == 6 else 5 - dow
    first = day_num + to_first
    first_dow = first % 7
    week_index = first // 7
    occurrence = week_index * 2 + (1 if first_dow == 6 else 0)
    target = occurrence + (n - 1)
    week, is_sunday = divmod(target, 2)
    return week * 7 + 5 + is_sunday
